_comment: Template for local secrets. Copy this file to app/src/main/assets/Secrets.json and fill in real values. That file is gitignored so keys never land in source control. It is bundled as an app asset and read at runtime by GooglePlacesClient. Restrict the key to package earth.outbound + the Places API (and Maps SDK for Android, for the map in an item's details) in the Google Cloud console. GoogleMapsAPIKey is optional: the Places key is used for the map when it is left empty.
